99 //! A list is a doubly linked list. That is, it is a Sequence that supports both
100 //! forward and backward traversal, and (amortized) constant time insertion and
101 //! removal of elements at the beginning or the end, or in the middle. Lists have
102 //! the important property that insertion and splicing do not invalidate iterators
103 //! to list elements, and that even removal invalidates only the iterators that point
104 //! to the elements that are removed. The ordering of iterators may be changed
105 //! (that is, list<T>::iterator might have a different predecessor or successor
106 //! after a list operation than it did before), but the iterators themselves will
107 //! not be invalidated or made to point to different elements unless that invalidation
108 //! or mutation is explicit.
109 //!
110 //! \tparam T The type of object that is stored in the list
111 //! \tparam Allocator The allocator used for all internal memory management, use void
112 //! for the default allocator
113 #ifdef BOOST_CONTAINER_DOXYGEN_INVOKED
114 template <class T, class Allocator = void >
115 #else
116 template <class T, class Allocator>
117 #endif
118 class list
119 : protected dtl::node_alloc_holder
120 < typename real_allocator<T, Allocator>::type
121 , typename dtl::intrusive_list_type<typename real_allocator<T, Allocator>::type>::type>
122 {
123 #ifndef BOOST_CONTAINER_DOXYGEN_INVOKED
124 typedef typename real_allocator<T, Allocator>::type ValueAllocator;
125 typedef typename
126 dtl::intrusive_list_type<ValueAllocator>::type Icont;
127 typedef dtl::node_alloc_holder<ValueAllocator, Icont> AllocHolder;
128 typedef typename AllocHolder::NodePtr NodePtr;
129 typedef typename AllocHolder::NodeAlloc NodeAlloc;
130 typedef typename AllocHolder::ValAlloc ValAlloc;
131 typedef typename AllocHolder::Node Node;
132 typedef dtl::allocator_node_destroyer<NodeAlloc> Destroyer;
133 typedef typename AllocHolder::alloc_version alloc_version;
134 typedef boost::container::allocator_traits<ValueAllocator> allocator_traits_type;
135 typedef boost::container::equal_to_value
136 <typename allocator_traits_type::value_type> equal_to_value_type;
137
138 BOOST_COPYABLE_AND_MOVABLE(list)
139
140 typedef dtl::iterator_from_iiterator<typename Icont::iterator, false> iterator_impl;
141 typedef dtl::iterator_from_iiterator<typename Icont::iterator, true> const_iterator_impl;
142 #endif //#ifndef BOOST_CONTAINER_DOXYGEN_INVOKED
143
